top.title: Dubai introduces digital Nol QR tickets for metro, buses and trams
top.teaser: Public transport passengers in Dubai can now use digital QR codes on their phones to access the metro, trams and buses, eliminating the need for a single-use red paper Nol ticket. Passengers can buy digital Nol QR tickets through the Nol Pay or S'hail apps, the Roads and Transport Authority announced. This option is especially convenient for occasional passengers and visitors who use red Nol ticke
top.impact_reason: Enhances daily urban mobility and transit convenience.
top.headline: Dubai launches digital Nol QR tickets for public transport
top.summary: Commuters can now use mobile QR codes for the metro, buses, and trams instead of paper tickets. The new digital option is available through the Nol Pay and S'hail applications.
top.why: Improves overall public transit convenience across the city.

top.title: India central bank takes steps to support rupee, opens dollar window for oil companies
top.teaser: REFILE-India central bank takes steps to support rupee, opens dollar window for oil companies
top.impact_reason: Minor effect on foreign exchange and overseas investments.
top.headline: India central bank opens dollar window to support rupee
top.summary: The Reserve Bank of India implemented measures to stabilize the national currency by offering a dollar window specifically for oil companies. These steps aim to ease pressure on the foreign exchange market.
top.why: Affects currency strength and NRI investment capital flows.
